preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 6 and 200,000.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1, as it is a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints must be valid vertex labels and distinct.

postconditions.description: The two paths must share at least two common vertices.
The total length of the two paths must be maximized.
The number of common vertices between the two paths must be maximized.
